main_text.p: mouerit,videatis quomodo vlteriore atq; lau­tiore quodam ferculo palatum explere poffit: auribus percipiendam,oculifq; lectitandam e­am propofui,non etiam deguftandam.

Nos melioribus(vtinam non peioribus)vi­viuédi inftitutis deliniti placidiorefq; redditi, quod ex cibis ferum omninò eft, relinquamus illis,alimentorumq; vim ac naturam memorâ­dam,diligenter perpendamus.vt fuauia,fami­liaria & amica diftinguamus ab iis,quæ naturę ac vitæ hominum noxia funt & inimica.

Omne autem animans fibi conueniente nutritur alimento. Alimentum eft quo alimur, vel fine quo corpus ali non poteft. Conueni­ens vnicuiq; alimentum eft, q̃ aflimilari cor­pori alendo poteft: ciborum enim ratio eft,af­fimilari & vniri fubftantiæ corporis cibandi.
Alimentum affimilandû vel efculentû eft vel potulentum. Efculentum eft q̃ efui eft aptum.

Efculenta fiue cibi quæ in hominum vfus ad­mittuntur,veniunt vel à vegetabilibus,vt fru­gibus,leguminibus,fructibus: vel ab animali­bus horumq; partibus, vel ab iis, quæ ab ani­malib. pueniunt, vt funt oua,lac,mel,fanguis.

De omnib.autem & fingulis in fpecie efcu­lentis,quæ vel à vegetabilib', vel ab animalib' depromi poffunt in vfus humanos,tractare in­ftituti,& confilii mei non eft, fed deiis folum­modo,quę noftra ætate crebrius veniunt in ci­bos & menfas. Ac qui de cibis hominû tracta­runt,

page.notes: Printing: "poffit" in line 1 and "mouerit" at the top are the first words of a sentence carried over from the previous page; the first line is therefore a continuation. Words written in the margin-less layout are all in the text block. Doubtful readings: "vlteriore" (possibly printed "vlteriore"), "affimilari" as printed; "deguftandam" as printed. The paragraph ending "tracta-runt," is cut off at the foot of the page and continues onto the next page. Show-through from the reverse side is ignored. Ligature-like "q̃" stands for "quo" abbreviation as printed; "vfus", "cibandi", "puenium" appear as printed and may be printing errors ("peruenium" would be expected). Text is in an older orthography with long s rendered as plain s.
